headline: Mercado Bitcoin Reports Security Incident Involving US$40 Million
summary: Mercado Bitcoin communicated a security incident to investors and temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals as a preventive measure, with non-official on-chain trackers estimating the amount at $40 million.
why: Cryptocurrency exchanges face operational and security risks where platform breaches can trigger liquidity freezes and erode investor confidence.

impacts.name: Mercado Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security incident and temporary suspension of deposits and withdrawals.
